items.title: Bill Allred interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 24, 2017
items.q: Like I sat in with Woody’s band one time when they played at Disney here, and played a couple of tunes with them.

ctx.x: Do you guys ever — I can just picture this scenario where your son calls you up and says, “Hey guess what I’m doing?” And you say, “Oh yeah, well guess what I’m doing.” Like one upsmanship.

It is. There’s a little bit of that. Like I sat in with Woody’s band one time when they played at Disney here, and played a couple of tunes with them. But no John, I always — a favorite barb I always lay on the people, I say, “Yeah it’s a special thing when you have a son that plays the same instrument as you.” I said, “There’s a defining moment in your life when your son looks at you and says, ‘no dad, it goes like this.’” And I don’t know if that actually happened like that but it did you know, and he’d help me…
Now he can do a Broadway show and —
